title: Cover Picture and Issue Information
content: Entangled aerial roots of Ficus macrophylla f. columnaris, Palermo Botanical Garden (Credit: Sandra Díaz). Sandra Díaz, author of the Calow-Grace review featured in this issue and who provided this cover image (https://doi.org/10.1111/1365-2435.70017), reviews concepts that have long been at the core of ecology and evolutionary biology but are at risk of being increasingly ignored. Sandra proposes ways of incorporating whole-phenotype and entangled perspectives in trait-based plant functional ecology, nature stewardship, and climate change mitigation and adaptation.
